notes.subject: בריח / מברח
notes.rationale: Bar (בריח) na verb ברח (bolim, ranawe) i wankain leta — 'bar i barim i go' — pasin bilong tok i lus long Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: i ran stret
notes.rationale: מברח hia em i 'em i makim i go braip' — verb bilong 'ranawe/bolim', mi usim 'ran stret' bilong lukim pasin bilong bar.

notes.subject: long ens i go long ens
notes.rationale: Ves i makim olgata spes bilong bar — long wanpela ens i go long narapela ens.

translation: Na bar bilong namel, we i stap long namel bilong ol bord, bai i ran stret — i go long wanpela ens i kamap long narapela ens.
